diagnosis.what_happened: Manifest composite sum scores were substituted for latent variables in SEM without measurement models.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: The model was technically a manifest path analysis rather than full SEM, ignoring measurement error.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Latent variables should have been specified with observed subscale indicators (=~) in lavaan, and multi-factor predictors decomposed into subscale factors.
diagnosis.rationale_why: SEM requires measurement models to account for error variance and isolate true structural paths.

desired_behavior: Never substitute manifest composite sum scores for latent variables when executing SEM. Always specify latent variables with observed subscale indicators (=~) in lavaan. Decompose multi-factor predictors into subscale factors when running regression on criterion variables.
generalization: Latent constructs require measurement model specification (=~) rather than composite sum extraction.
